title: Help
contactEmailText: Open your email app to write to us?
q1: How to start my first exercise?
a1: Go to the Home tab and choose an exercise. Each has step-by-step guidance.
q2: How to change my weekly goal?
a2: Go to Profile → Edit profile and set minutes per week.
q3: What are achievements and how to earn them?
a3: Achievements reward regularity and progress. Train and meet goals.
q4: Can I exercise with health issues?
a4: Exercises are adapted to various levels. Consult a clinician if unsure.
q5: How long should an exercise last?
a5: Most exercises last 3–15 minutes. Choose according to your time.
a6: Profile → Settings → Notifications. Select time and days.
tip1Desc: 10 minutes daily is better than 1 hour once a week.
tip2Desc: Start small and increase gradually to keep motivation.
tip3Desc: Configure reminders to build a consistent habit.
